policy: Simulated post-gain local speaker writes arrive 40 ms ahead of playout throughout panel-only calibration. Separate causal FIR fitted on 4 s and validated on 750 ms. After electrical reference loss, either keep its filter, subtract the writer prediction when two ADC blocks are all zero, or also require a measured reduction of mic residual energy over the latest eight blocks. Include +/-20 ms write-clock jumps and writes that continue while the actual speaker is muted. All routes have the prior common 16 ms output delay, C161 and frozen linear early gate. Host PCM suffix ASR. These write-clock leads, loss signatures and room paths are simulated.
